description: This file defines the class DefaultPersistenceStreamingActor, a final class extending AbstractPersistenceStreamingActor, providing constructors and factory methods for creating Akka Props objects for streaming persistence actors in a MongoDB-based persistence layer. It is part of the org.eclipse.ditto.services.utils.persistence.mongo package and is tailored for entities implementing EntityIdWithRevision.

classes.name: DefaultPersistenceStreamingActor
classes.description: A final class extending AbstractPersistenceStreamingActor, providing mechanisms to instantiate actors with specific entity classes and mappers for persistence streams.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Static factory method to create Props for a DefaultPersistenceStreamingActor given an entity class and mapping functions.

methods.name: propsForTests
methods.description: Static method to create Props for testing purposes, with an additional MongoReadJournal parameter.

methods.name: getElementClass
methods.description: Returns the entity class associated with this actor.
